component.description: The component this object classifies. Exactly this value.

value.description: The activation_state value: one of ["Accelerating","Transitioning","Stable","Contracting"], or null when the facts do not support a defensible answer.

evidence.description: At most 6 items, each "<fact_key>: <value>" and under 200 characters. The limits are not expressible in strict mode; they are still the contract.

confidence.description: high when a fact states it or two agree; medium when inferred; low when extrapolating.

missing_inputs.description: Fact keys you needed and did not get. Empty array when none.

evidence_dated_within_months.description: Required when value is "Contracting": the age in months of the dated evidence item, which must be within 12 months. Null otherwise.
